text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I placed! Guess we can breathe a 
sigh of relief for now?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't be satisfied with this. 
Aaagh, I really wanted to take 1st 
place...!

Well of course it's fun! I mean, I'm 
running!

text_block_list.text:
...Wait, scratch that. Have I been acting 
kinda dumb lately?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Given the way things played out, that 
doesn't make me happy in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let me redo it! In the next race, I'll 
take 1st place and say something that 
sounds way more like "me"!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Getting provoked by you really rubs me the 
wrong way.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're right, though—just moping around is 
lame. Fine, I'll say what you want to 
hear.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm taking 1st place next time.’ So 
you'd better make sure I run the best race 
possible, got it?!"
